subtitle: Lesson 5 · Chapter 1: The First Support Ticket Report

code:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CREATED_AT)::DATE AS TICKET_DATE,
  PRIORITY,
  COUNT(*) AS TICKET_COUNT
FROM DRIFTWOOD_ANALYTICS.SUPPORT.RAW_TICKETS
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CREATED_AT)
    = DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY TICKET_DATE, PRIORITY
ORDER BY TICKET_DATE, PRIORITY;
caption: One row per day, per priority — exactly the grain decided in Lesson 1.

eyebrow: Reading the query, piece by piece

steps.label: GROUP BY + COUNT(*)
steps.sub: the actual metric, at the right grain

code:
-- Wrong tool: HAVING filters groups, after the fact
-- Right tool: WHERE filters rows, before grouping
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CREATED_AT)
    = DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE())
caption: Filtering in WHERE means Snowflake never even touches last month's rows.
Rolling daily counts back up by priority catches an obviously wrong query early.
